reason: I find my date-night plans on Instagram and just DM the venue or use the link in bio, and that costs me nothing extra. On a student-type budget I don't see why I'd pay R8 a booking, plus R5 if I want it on WhatsApp, for something I already do for free.
objection: R8 on top of every booking adds up, and it's gone even if I cancel. If the venue already sells tickets through Instagram, the app is just a middleman taking a cut from me.
would_change_my_mind: If Trove had date-night experiences I can't find or book on Instagram, or no booking fee on my first few bookings so I could see if the escrow and refund protection is actually worth it.
